subject: ceri-clairmont
q: Is Cyrena a carpenter or a ritual tattooist? Her own record says both, in two different fields.
detail:
ANSWERED. NEITHER FIELD WAS THE PROBLEM — THE TURNING WAS. Her original profile had her as a WOODWORKER AND ARCHERY TRAINER with a hobby for hunting. That somehow became RITUAL TATTOOIST, and Viraena’s ruling is that THE TURNING IS THE PART THAT IS WRONG.

Ritual Tattooist is struck from her row. The deep-profile note that had been contradicting it for builds was correct all along and has been corrected forward to name all three: woodworker, archery trainer, hunter. See c-ceri-trade.
